messages:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout marker: release/2026-03-20 v3.14.0 -> prod
deploy-bot: Canary group: svc=api, region=us-west-2, initial traffic=5% for 15m. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-backout
michelle: watching. Key checks: 95p latency, error rate, memory RSS. If 95p > 400ms OR 5xx rate > 0.5% for 3 consecutive mins -> backout.
dan: +1 on thresholds. Do we have a stable image to pin back to? last stable: registry/redwood/api:v3.13.4
sara: confirmed. prod-overlay has image pinned to v3.13.4 as the previous good revision. fallback plan: pin image + scale to previous replica count.
lee: tagging oncall. @oncall-jordan are you ready to trigger if alerts fire?
oncall-jordan: I'm watching the canary dashboard. If 5xx > 1% in any two-minute window I'll run the backout unless I see a clear reason to hold.
michelle: also abort on feature-flag spike: ff/fast-path errors >10% -> immediate abort.
dan: Backout commands (keeps it simple):
```bash
# rollback to stable image
kubectl -n prod set image deployment/api api=registry/redwood/api:v3.13.4
kubectl -n prod rollout status deployment/api
# if we need to pin in repo overlay (manual step)
cd infra/kustomize/prod-overlay && git revert --no-edit <deploy-commit-hash> && git push origin prod-overlay
```
eng-tools-bot: Runbook snippet attached to ticket INF-912 and created a short checklist: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INF-912#runbook
michelle: timeline we agreed: canary 15m -> ramp to 30% for 10m -> full. Any manual backout aborts the ramp and forces revert.
dan: after backout, open a postmortem and cut a hotfix branch from the last known-good commit.
sara: note for DB watchers: migrations here are "non-destructive" but monitor replica lag & migration errors (binlog).
lee: I'll hold the traffic router controls and be ready to cut traffic to dedicated pool if the canary looks bad.
michelle: added two extra quick checks to the runbook: cache invalidation list & circuit-breaker health.
eng-tools-bot: Added deploy annotations: deployment_id=deploy-1812345678, runbook=deploy-backout.
michelle: please ack when you're in position. :eyes: :thumbsup:
dan: acked, I'm on standby.
sara: ack, monitoring dashboards open.
lee: ack, traffic controls ready.
oncall-jordan: ack, will notify when I start any rollback actions.
michelle: last check-in (1812345840): canary stable at 15m mark, no signal breaches. continuing to ramp per schedule.
